properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TripleDES as shipped in crypto-js 4.2.0: src/tripledes.js implements the cipher and registers the C.TripleDES helper; grunt/config/modularize.js builds the tripledes module into the distributed bundles; the test files exercise it with ECB/NoPadding vectors. Changeable here — this is first-party source. 3DES is classically broken (64-bit block, Sweet32; deprecation by NIST) independent of quantum concerns.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RC4/RC4Drop as shipped in crypto-js 4.2.0: src/rc4.js implements the stream cipher and RC4Drop variant, registers C.RC4; the build manifest and package keyword advertise it; tests exercise it. RC4 is classically broken (biases, no IV) — an outstanding defect, not a PQ-migration item. Changeable here — first-party source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 is a shipped, tested primitive of the crypto-js library itself (src/md5.js implements it; the build ships the md5 component and exports CryptoJS.MD5). All 20 sites are genuine MD5 digest operations in the library's YUI conformance suite — including two Rabbit tests that derive a cipher key from a passphrase with C.MD5('Jefe'). Changeable here by removing/deprecating the module; the test suite only exercises what src/ already implements.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 as shipped in crypto-js 4.2.0: test/sha1-test.js and test/sha1-profile.js exercise the shipped C.SHA1/C.algo.SHA1 implementation (registered in src/sha1.js, which the HMAC-SHA-1 object also covers). These are real hash computations against published vectors, part of the library's own QA — not a rule table. Changeable here; SHA-1 is collision-broken classically, independent of quantum concerns.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-MD5 as shipped in crypto-js 4.2.0: src/md5.js registers C.HmacMD5 (HMAC over the MD5 hasher), exposed by name in the build manifest and exercised by RFC 2202 test vectors. Shipped API surface; changeable here. HMAC-MD5's underlying MD5 is collision-broken; tag truncation aside, the MAC primitive is deprecated.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECB mode is a shipped configuration option of the crypto-js build: src/mode-ecb.js defines CryptoJS.mode.ECB, selectable by any consumer of AES/TripleDES/Blowfish via cfg.mode. The test at test/mode-ecb-test.js verifies it. Changeable here only by removing the module from the shipped build (grunt/config/modularize.js).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CMAC (OMAC1/OMAC2) implemented inside the test suite to exercise cipher-core.js's BlockCipher extension hooks (cipher-test.js:512 says so explicitly). Not part of the shipped npm component list — it is available in this repo only through the test bundle — but it is real, executable block-cipher MAC code over AES. Note for the CBOM: this is CMAC (SP 800-38B), not GMAC; no GCM/GMAC exists anywhere in this repository.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA-1 as shipped in crypto-js 4.2.0: src/sha1.js:129 registers C.HmacSHA1 (HMAC over the SHA-1 hasher); the build manifest exports it by name; test/sha1-test.js:67 exercises it with the RFC 2202 'Hi There' vector. Shipped API surface; sound as a MAC today but deprecated everywhere; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA-256/384/512 as shipped in crypto-js 4.2.0: src/sha256.js:178, sha384.js:62 and sha512.js:305 register C.HmacSHA256/384/512 via _createHmacHelper; the build manifest exports them; the test suites exercise them with RFC 4231 vectors. Current best-practice MACs, PQ-relevant only insofar as Grover halves tag security. Changeable here; first-party source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 is the library's modern password KDF: shipped implementation with default cfg keySize 128 bits, HMAC-SHA-256, 250,000 iterations (src/pbkdf2.js:20-26 — raised from 1 in v4.0). Test vectors use RFC 6070's deliberately low iteration counts (1, 2, 5, 50, 1200); those are conformance fixtures, not shipped defaults. Consumers calling C.PBKDF2(password, salt) with no cfg get the 250k SHA-256 default.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is the library's default modern hash (default hasher for PBKDF2, HMAC-SHA256, etc.), implemented in src/sha256.js and exercised by its conformance suite. Also feeds src/sha224.js (SHA-224) and the HMAC/evpkdf components in the shipped build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-384/SHA-512 are the library's CNSA-2.0-grade hashes (src/sha512.js, src/sha384.js), shipped and conformance-tested. These are the PQ-appropriate digest sizes; they also back HmacSHA384/512 in the build.
